##====================================================
## Full working code with scale y continuous liver DIP 
##====================================================


```{r}
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggprism)

# ── Function ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_leber_boxplot <- function(
    all_data,
    diabetic_data,
    gender_data1,
    panel = "gpt",
    unit_map = NULL,
    comparisons = list(
      c("Liver_Diclo", "Liver_Ibu"),
      c("Liver_Diclo", "Liver_Para"),
      c("Liver_Ibu",   "Liver_Para")
    ),
    stat_method  = "wilcox.test",
    stat_label   = "p.format",
    tip_length   = 0.01,
    bracket_size = 0.5,
    n_breaks     = 7,
    top_margin   = 80,
    colors = c(
      "Liver_Diclo" = "#4E79A7",
      "Liver_Ibu"   = "#F28E2B",
      "Liver_Para"  = "#59A14F"
    )
) {

  # ── Dynamic title & axis label ────────────────────────────────────────────
  plot_title <- paste(toupper(panel), "Levels by treatment (Liver Cohort)")

  y_label <- if (!is.null(unit_map) &&
               panel %in% names(unit_map)) {
  unit_map[[panel]]
} else if (exists("unit_map", inherits = TRUE)) {
  unit_map[[panel]]
} else {
  toupper(panel)
}

  # ── Data wrangling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  plot_data <- all_data %>%
    full_join(diabetic_data,
              by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
              relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    full_join(gender_data1,
              by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
              relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(
      panel_id == .env$panel,
      grepl("Leber_", treatment),
      !str_detect(attribute, "_krankheitsbeginn|dbs|_from_start|_From Start"),
      !is.na(diabetes),
      !is.na(treatment),
      !is.na(labreads)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = recode(
        treatment,
        "Leber_Diclo" = "Liver_Diclo",
        "Leber_Ibu"   = "Liver_Ibu",
        "Leber_Para"  = "Liver_Para"
      )
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data remaining after filtering.")
  }

  # ── Group stats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  group_stats <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n_distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ── X labels (N under group name) ────────────────────────────────────────
  x_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(group_stats$treatment, "\nN = ", group_stats$N),
    group_stats$treatment
  )

  # ── Y calculations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  y_max <- max(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_comp <- length(comparisons)

  label_y_pos <- y_max * (1.10 + seq(0, by = 0.10, length.out = n_comp))
  plot_top <- max(label_y_pos) * 1.15

  # fixed n position (inside plot)
  n_y <- y_max * 1.05

  # ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = treatment,
      y = labreads,
      fill = treatment,
      colour = treatment
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.6,
      alpha = 0.35,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(shape = treatment),
      width = 0.2,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +

    # n inside plot
    geom_text(
      data = group_stats,
      aes(
        x = treatment,
        y = n_y,
        label = paste0("n = ", n)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4.5
    ) +

    # statistics
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = stat_method,
      label = stat_label,
      label.y = label_y_pos,
      tip.length = tip_length,
      bracket.size = bracket_size,
      step.increase = 0,
      size = 6
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_shape_prism() +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = n_breaks),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, plot_top),
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    guides(y = "prism_offset_minor") +

    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +

    theme_prism() +

    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),

      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 26,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(b = 4),
        lineheight = 1.2
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 6),
        hjust = 0.5,
        vjust = 1
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 24,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = 10, unit = "pt")
      ),

      axis.text.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.top = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = ifelse(is.null(top_margin), 80, top_margin),
        r = 10,
        b = 10,
        l = 10,
        unit = "pt"
      )
    )

  return(p)
}
```

##==============================================================================
##  format code for y axis break when outlier exist.
##==============================================================================


```{r}
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggbreak)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggprism)

# ── Function ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_liver_boxplot_break <- function(
    all_data,
    diabetic_data,
    gender_data1,
    panel = "gpt",
    unit_map = NULL,
    comparisons = list(
      c("Liver_Diclo", "Liver_Ibu"),
      c("Liver_Diclo", "Liver_Para"),
      c("Liver_Ibu",   "Liver_Para")
    ),
    stat_method   = "wilcox.test",
    stat_label    = "p.format",
    tip_length    = 0.01,
    bracket_size  = 0.5,
    y_break       = c(3000, 4500),
    y_break_scale = 0.3,
    top_margin    = 80,
    colors        = c(
      "Liver_Diclo" = "#4E79A7",
      "Liver_Ibu"   = "#F28E2B",
      "Liver_Para"  = "#59A14F"
    )
) {

  # ── Title & label ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  plot_title <- paste(toupper(panel), "Levels by treatment (Liver Cohort)")

  y_label <- if (!is.null(unit_map) && panel %in% names(unit_map)) {
    unit_map[[panel]]
  } else {
    toupper(panel)
  }

  # ── Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  plot_data <- all_data %>%
    full_join(diabetic_data,
              by = c("bf_ar_m_nummer","treatment"),
              relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    full_join(gender_data1,
              by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
              relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      filter(
      panel_id == .env$panel,
      grepl("Leber_", treatment),
      !str_detect(attribute, "_krankheitsbeginn|dbs|_from_start|_From Start"),
      !is.na(diabetes),
      !is.na(treatment),
      !is.na(labreads)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      treatment = recode(
        treatment,
        "Leber_Diclo" = "Liver_Diclo",
        "Leber_Ibu"   = "Liver_Ibu",
        "Leber_Para"  = "Liver_Para"
      )
    ) 

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data remaining after filtering.")
  }

  # ── Stats ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  group_stats <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n_distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer),
      n = n(),
      y_top = max(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  x_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(group_stats$treatment, "\nN = ", group_stats$N),
    group_stats$treatment
  )

  # ── y scaling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  y_max <- max(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)

  n_comp <- length(comparisons)

  label_y_pos <- y_max * (1.28 + seq(0, by = 0.10, length.out = n_comp))

  plot_top <- max(label_y_pos) * 1.10

  n_label_y <- y_max * 1.05

  # ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = treatment,
      y = labreads,
      fill = treatment,
      colour = treatment
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.6,
      alpha = 0.35,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(shape = treatment),
      width = 0.2,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = group_stats,
      aes(x = treatment,
          y = n_label_y,
          label = paste0("n = ", n)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    ) +

    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons  = comparisons,
      method       = stat_method,
      label        = stat_label,
      label.y      = label_y_pos,
      tip.length   = tip_length,
      bracket.size = bracket_size,
      step.increase = 0.11,
      size = 5
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_shape_prism() +

    scale_y_break(y_break, scales = y_break_scale) +
    expand_limits(y = max(label_y_pos) * 1.55) +
    guides(y = "prism_offset_minor") +

    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +

    theme_prism() +

    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 26,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(b = 6)
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 6)
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 24,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = -10, unit = "pt")
      ),

      axis.text.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.top = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = top_margin,
        r = 10,
        b = 10,
        l = 10,
        unit = "pt"
      )
    )

  return(p)
}
```

##==============================================================================
## Diabetic vs non_diabetic boxplots (facet by gender)
##==============================================================================



```{r}
plot_gender_diabetes_boxplot <- function(
    all_data,
    diabetic_data,
    gender_data,
    panel,
    unit_map = NULL
) {

  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(rstatix)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggprism)

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # DATA
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  plot_data <- all_data %>%
    left_join(
      diabetic_data,
      by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      gender_data1,
      by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      panel_id == .env$panel,
      grepl("Leber_", treatment),
      !str_detect(attribute, "_krankheitsbeginn|dbs"),
      !is.na(diabetes),
      !is.na(gender),
      !is.na(treatment),
      !is.na(labreads)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = recode(
        treatment,
        "Leber_Diclo" = "Liver_Diclo",
        "Leber_Ibu"   = "Liver_Ibu",
        "Leber_Para"  = "Liver_Para"
      ),
      diabetes = factor(diabetes, levels = c("Diabetic", "Non_Diabetic")),
      gender   = factor(gender,   levels = c("Female", "Male"))
    ) %>%
    distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer, labreads, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data available after filtering.")
  }

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Y AXIS SETTINGS
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  y_max        <- max(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min        <- min(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)
  label_space  <- y_max * 0.20

  # FIX: use additive offset so the bottom label zone is always
  # inside ylim regardless of whether y values are positive or negative
  y_bottom_plot <- y_min - label_space
  y_top_plot    <- y_max * 1.25

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # N COUNTS (PATIENTS)
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  N_counts <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(gender, diabetes) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n_distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("N=", N),
    y = y_bottom_plot - label_space * 1.30   # near the very bottom of ylim
  )

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # n COUNTS (OBSERVATIONS)
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  n_counts <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(gender, diabetes) %>%
    summarise(
      # FIX: n() counts rows (unique patient-labread pairs after distinct()),
      # NOT n_distinct(labreads) which would collapse identical numeric values
      # from different patients into one count
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      label = paste0("n=", n),
      # place n label just below the p-value bracket zone
      y = y_max * 1.17
    )

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # P VALUES
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  pvals <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    counts <- table(.x$diabetes)
    # Need both groups present AND each with at least 3 observations
    if (length(counts) < 2 || any(counts < 3)) {
      message("Skipping p-value for gender = ", unique(.x$gender),
              " — insufficient observations: ", paste(names(counts), counts, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
      return(tibble())   # return empty → no bracket drawn for this facet
    }
    wilcox_test(.x, labreads ~ diabetes)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Only compute positions and draw brackets if any tests succeeded
if (nrow(pvals) > 0) {
  pvals <- pvals %>%
    mutate(
      group1     = "Diabetic",
      group2     = "Non_Diabetic",
      y.position = y_max * 1.10,
      p.label    = paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))
    )
}

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # UNIT LABEL
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  y_label <- if (!is.null(unit_map) && panel %in% names(unit_map)) {
    unit_map[[panel]]
  } else {
    toupper(panel)
  }

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # TITLE
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  plot_title <- paste0(
    toupper(panel),
    ": Diabetic vs Non-Diabetic by Gender"
  )

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # PLOT
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = diabetes, y = labreads, fill = diabetes)) +

    geom_boxplot(width = 0.30, 
                 outlier.shape = NA, 
                 alpha = 0.5, 
                 color = "black") +

    geom_jitter(
      width  = 0.15,
      alpha  = 0.3,
      size   = 1.8,
      color  = "#CC79A7"
    ) +

    # n label (observations) — sits above the p-value bracket
    geom_text(
      data = n_counts,
      aes(x = diabetes, 
          y = y, 
          label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size      = 7,
      fontface  = "bold"
    ) +

    # N label (patients) — sits in the bottom margin
    geom_text(
      data = N_counts,
      aes(x = diabetes, 
          y = y, 
          label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size      = 7,
      fontface  = "bold"
    ) +

    { if (nrow(pvals) > 0)
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pvals,
      label      = "p.label",
      xmin       = "group1",
      xmax       = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      size = 5,
      tip.length = 0.01
    )
} +

    facet_wrap(~gender, nrow = 1) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_bottom_plot, y_top_plot),
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x     = NULL,
      y     = y_label
    ) +

    theme_prism() +

    theme(
   plot.title      = element_text(size = 26,face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
   strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
   axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 22,angle = 0, hjust = 0.5,
                                 margin = margin(b=2)),
   axis.text.y = element_text(size = 22,face = "bold"),
   axis.title = element_text(size = 24,face = "bold" ),
   legend.position = "none",
   plot.margin     = margin(t = 15, 
                           r = 15, 
                           b = 40, 
                           l = 15)  # increased b from 55 → 80
)

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
base_dir <- here::here("output/figure/diabetes/plots_all_labvalues/liver_diabetic_nondiabitic_gender")

panels <- c("ck", "keratinkinase", "quick", "inr", "troponin", "prothrombin",
  "ptt", "tz", "antithrombin", "serummyoglobin", "d", "fibrinogen",
  "leukozyten", "got", "gpt", "ggt", "ldh", "gldh", "triglyceride",
  "cholesterin", "hdl", "ldl", "lymphozyten", "hb", "total", "totales",
  "blut", "bilirubin", "direktes", "indirektes", "gesamteiweiss", "ap",
  "cholinesterase", "kreatinin", "amylase", "lipase", "crp", "harnstoff",
  "harnsaure", "erythrozyten", "thrombozyten", "trhombozyten", "haptoglobin",
  "bsg", "monozyten", "eosinophile", "neutrophile", "stabkernige",
  "segmentkernige", "basophile", "albumin", "gamma", "alpha", "beta",
  "hamatokrit", "mcv", "mch", "mchc", "natrium", "kalium", "kalzium",
  "magnesium", "chlorid", "serum", "transferrin", "ferritin", "fieber",
  "glucose", "ammoniak", "lactat", "phosphat", "glomarulare", "gfr",
  "ck_mb", "antithrombin_3", "total_bilirubin", "direct_bilirubin",
  "indirect_bilirubin", "serum_eisen", "grf")



for (panel in panels) {

  message("Processing: ", panel)

  p <- tryCatch(
    plot_gender_diabetes_boxplot(
      all_data      = all_data,
      diabetic_data = diabetic_data,
      gender_data   = gender_data1,
      panel         = panel,
      unit_map      = unit_map
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("No data available after filtering", e$message)) {
        message("Skipping ", panel, " (no data)")
        return(NULL)
      }
      stop(e)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(p)) next

  ggsave(
    file.path(svg_dir, paste0(panel, "_boxplot.svg")),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(png_dir, paste0(panel, "_boxplot.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )

  message("Saved: ", panel)
}
```
